Part of [AGENTIC-2895](https://linear.app/agenticassets/issue/AGENTIC-2895).

`buildout_observation_artifact.py` is a **standalone, no-network, no-database** builder for a saved local Buildout feed page or an already retained observation array. It is not wired into the collector, an ingest command, a scheduler, or a production writer. It makes no claim that a source is available, a page is complete, or a listing identity is resolved. The source key is supplied by the operator and is labeled accordingly; source-native IDs and URLs remain literal, unvalidated source fields. Every retained record's `identityResolution` is `unresolved`.

The builder records the input byte hash and retains bounded page and row fields, including nested JSON and ordered attribute pairs with duplicate labels, false, null, and original unit text. Numbers retain decimal value and precision, but output JSON is re-encoded; the original input is the authority for exact bytes and numeric spelling. It does not derive address, transaction, lifecycle, or property identity. A retained-observations input can only preserve what that earlier capture retained; its upstream omission counts are reported and missing counts remain unknown. No builder can reconstruct fields absent from its input.

Known credential-shaped fields, values, and unclassifiable URL query material are quarantined, with original input positions and reasons. A quarantined value is represented by an explicit marker, never a fabricated source value; unsafe field names are omitted with the original object ordinal. Malformed attribute pairs and values over the per-value limit are also quarantined. Whole-input size, nesting, record and output limits fail rather than silently truncate. Keep the original input privately to recover quarantine entries. The report counts them and marks the artifact partial; it does not preserve quarantined content in the output.

**The credential checks are not a confidentiality guarantee.** Real source data may contain credentials, client details, or other sensitive information the checks miss. Both input and output are unreviewed private data: do not commit, share, upload, or feed the artifact to ingestion. Output is exclusively created with mode 0600 and cannot overwrite an existing path or follow a final symlink. The caller controls parent directories, which are not sandboxed or authenticated. Do not print the artifact or raw source data in logs.

From a standalone `git clone --no-hardlinks`, run `python3 -m pytest tests/test_buildout_observation_artifact.py -q`. For an operator-owned saved page, provide `--input PATH --input-kind buildout-page --source-key SOURCE --out PRIVATE_NEW_PATH`; for an already retained array, select `--input-kind retained-observations`. This is read-only with respect to the saved input and all external systems, but creates the requested local artifact. Review source rights, confidentiality, retention, and any later database writer independently.
